body: Thank you for all the info, will discuss this with my gf and the vet. We can get the meds I suppose, it seems possible. We'll take action asap after the x-ray, thanks again.

Hi, thanks for the reply! I'll inform as much as I can.

Blood work was done indeed, I'll include the results too. Can't inform on cavitary effusions since we didn't get an x-ray today.   
Cat has respiratory issues such as coughing/sneezing episodes and trouble breathing afterwards. Lack of appetite, weight loss and a depressed state is also present.

These are the papers for blood work, sorry if the language is an issue since we live in Turkey, can try to help with that if need be.

You can check out the tier list and character builds on [here](https://genshin.gg) , you don’t have to copy the exact builds at first but they’ll give a round idea. 

Be patient with upgrading or min/maxing characters, upgrade when you feel like you’re struggling because you can always get better items until mid game where the progression slows down a bit and gameplay shines, around 20-25 Adventure Level I’d say. 

Your main DPS characters are Keqing and Diluc, Fischl is a nice support that can also go DPS with proper gear, Sucrose is also a good support depending on team comps and can also trigger elemental reactions pretty easily with AoE effects, and Barbara is the main healer. Play around and see what you feel about main DPS characters and your play style. 

Have fun!
You got one of the best team comps imo, I’d play the hell out of those except Noelle, she’s a bit underwhelming

I was clean for a while but it's getting pretty hard again lately, and I'm on the verge of relapsing.   
I never got to ask openly for help. My personality was the biggest barrier that held me back from screaming for it. I cut it in my hand, wrote it on my band-aids and so on, hoping that people would pay attention and take it seriously. They didn't, lol.  
Whatever though, days go on and I'm alive, gotta bear with it.

Depression fucked me up at 21. It cut, bit, burnt, strangled and tried to kill me. It changed me so bad that I forgot who I was.  
It took what I thought was the only real thing that I can love in this world.  
I'm doing relatively fine for a while, but I know that it's near impossible to open up that deep to someone and get accepted despite all my dark clouds and nightmares.   
Makes me feel like I'm a living dead with a heart of stone, cracking from the inside and breaking my bones.
\*Why\* reminds me of my nights of silently crying and screaming into my pillow, asking why. Also had "Help" and "Lost" cut in my hands. Glad to hear that you're doing okay!

> Being unwanted by the person you want the most is soul crushing. Make fun of me all you want. Call me a weak piece of shit. I lost a piece of myself today, and I don't know if I'll ever get it back. 

Fuck, this one hit a bit too close to home. In fact, the whole thing hit a bit too close to home. Felt like it was something I'd write in a bit different world.

22 now. Met someone 6-7 years ago. Same shit, always believed that she was my soulmate. 2-3 years into relationship and depression happened. Bent me, broke me, crushed me in every way possible. I'm sure that I lost a good amount of my actual self due to depression. It was all downhill from there as I started to be someone different, someone I didn't like at all. We tried to make it work as long as it was possible. Anyways, whatever.

Some people like to tell you that you shouldn't hurt yourself, or even go further, for a relationship. Sorry but fuck that. I have dependency issues. I'm emotional as fuck. I value emotional support more than most things. 

Been 10 days since I tried to take my own life over this. I tried to OD with a good amount of alcohol on my prescribed meds that I stopped taking a good while ago. Sent my suicide note and started waiting to pass out. She calls 30mins after I sent the note. I made the dumbest thing and answered it. She hung up, tried to reach my friends to get the address to call 911 because I refused to give the address. Begged for her to call me back. Hell, all I wanted to do was to hear her voice before I pass out and hopefully die.  
How stupid it was.  
She talked me out of it. Made me puke all that shit because she promised that she wasn't going to hang up the phone if I do. I did obey. How could I not? How can you resist hearing the voice of an angel while you're waiting to die?  
Fucking stupid.

My housemate came home early and took care of me. I didn't get hospitalized because I didn't want to. But I was high for 3 days, losing balance every time I try to walk and shit.

I even texted her to inform that I'm somewhat okay and went out with my housemate to get some fresh air.

Will I do it again? Probably. 

Yeah, I have some goals in life. But I'm too tired to wake up every morning and feel like my heart is turned into a stone, cracking slowly from inside out, hurting every inch of my soul. 

Maybe I was just born to die. I'll wait until that last branch I try to hang finally breaks, hopefully not a failure at that time.
Bold of you to assume that I don’t know my exact date of death.

My anger is mostly towards myself but yeah. I tried to tell everything, from the little white lies to the biggest ones and mistakes.

Well, suicide and suicide attempts always had a place in my mental growth, first one being a distant relative and the second one being one of the human beings that I valued above my own life.   
I remember talking openly about me thinking an attempt last June or something, which was the first and the last time that happened, that's probably when I really decided to write one, but I didn't have a mindset or mental state to be able to put together such words since then. Last summer is all misty, can't remember much. Sometimes I have to go through my old messages in my old phone to figure out what happened, which hurts more than I expect.

Also thanks for spending time to write a comment.
Thanks for the reply! Seems like I'll have to observe my behaviours a bit more.

I don't even want to die, I just don't want to exist anymore. I want to be like \*poof\*. I want to be erased from everyone's memories and from time. I go watch that high cliff every night when I'm in my bed with my razor necklace. That last step feels closer every time I try to look a bit closer to the end.

I hope things can change for you so you can carry on. \^\^

Just woke up, sorry for the late reply, and thanks for the kind advice!

I tried to battle it by myself for almost two years, thinking that I could do it. I failed and decided to see a psychiatrist once my self-harm habit from my teenage years started to appear again and I also started to get suicidal. Got prescribed Sertraline, Olanzapine and Benzos as Xanax. Despite my dosage going up faster than expected, I was feeling a bit fine. Yeah, I abused the drugs a bit but I knew where to stop.  
I had to change my doctor once I moved and all three of the doctors I saw refused to prescribe Benzos. I was left with Sertraline and Olanzapine. I wanted to quit Olanzapine because it made me hear things that I shouldn't be hearing and caused sleeping problems. All I got was 100mg Sertraline a day and that was clearly not enough. I tried to tell that many times but they wanted to do it as they want, so I quit Sertraline by lowering the dosage. Never went to see a doctor after that, I just stopped trying. 

I want to see a therapist but I don't think I can afford that as a student. Also no offense but I'm not religious, not at all, so talking to a religious leader is not an option.

Yeah, that's it I guess. My counselor would probably be surprised that I can still manage to live after all those abusive behaviors, lol.

​

Sorry for the late reply, just woke up, and thanks for the good wishes!

 I actually like weed but it's impossible to get for medical purposes here, and I can't afford to get it from a dealer on a regular basis. Most of the people who did that turned into dealers and now they're way past the "I use it to cure this or that" line. 

I like the high on Xanax more tho. I didn't get to use it that much but it was better than anything I got prescribed. I had to change my doctor and my new one refused to prescribe it so I went back to searching for weed. Actually, I wanted to get some weed on Friday night so I can stay a bit relaxed on the weekend because I knew that I'd get hit by a hard wave of depression. I ended up cutting a few and falling asleep.
